configurations.name: app-web
runtimeArgs: cd app && exec flutter run -d web-server --release --web-hostname 127.0.0.1 --web-port 8090 --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api

configurations.name: app-web-offline
runtimeArgs: cd app && exec flutter run -d web-server --release --web-hostname 127.0.0.1 --web-port 8091 --dart-define=USE_FAKE_API=true
